feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 June 2026 10:41pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 16 June 2026 at 10:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with weak fronts affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 for a time tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Patchy rain at times, with areas of mist and fog patches developing overnight, clearing to become mainly fair during the morning tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the west of the area Thursday morning, and in all waters Thursday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate in all waters by Thursday afternoon.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then outbreaks of rain developing overnight into Thursday, becoming patchier in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
